text:
jamie_product: quick thread to capture handshake + resume + finish_reason decisions. customers asked for small resume tokens, deterministic finish codes, and a way for older clients to keep working.

ana_devex: echo. mobile wants minimal bytes and explicit final marker. proxies sometimes drop long SSE; also iOS backgrounding kills sockets.

tessa_sdk: propose a tiny handshake header on connect: `X-Stream-Mode: structured|text|compat` and `X-Resume-Capable: 1`. server replies with `X-Server-Modes` and `X-Resume-TTL`. that keeps network round trips minimal.

mike_infra: transport note: SSE -> newline-delimited JSON works. WS -> either same JSON frames or a compact prefix (1 byte type + varint seq + payload). compact binary helps for high qps.

saurabh_pm: finish reasons proposal: `complete`, `truncated`, `stop`, `function_result`, `function_partial`, `user_cancel`, `error`. keep them short ascii tokens so telemetry easier.

luis_mobile: resume token must be an opaque base64 string <= 256 bytes and issued every N seconds or when model emitted >M tokens. mobile suggestion: every 3s or 200 tokens. reconnect flow: client sends token + preferred mode, server streams deltas from cursor.

tessa_sdk: compatibility approach: default server behavior during deprecation window = if client requests `text` send classic token events; if `structured` send structured chunks; if `compat` send both but include `dup_hint: true` in header so SDKs can dedupe. after deprecation, `compat` denied.

mike_infra: ops gating: stream finish_reason must be present in 99% of finished streams; resume success >= 96% under sims. also need canary to validate WS sticky scaling.

saurabh_pm: QA: create a test bundle with nested function calls, multi-stop tokens and artificially dropped connections to assert reconstruction and correct finish_reason mapping.

jamie_product: rollout plan: beta (staging) next week with `compat` default, collect metrics for 4 weeks, then flip default to `structured` and document migration. add SDK examples for iOS/Android/web.

staging-bot: canary scheduled: 2026-05-10T09:00Z (canary: stream-handshake-2240).

ana_devex: one more ask: include `finish.meta` with `model_id` and `prompt_sha` (tiny strings) for debugging.

jamie_product: agreed. action items: mike_infra -> implement handshake + checkpoint tokens, tessa_sdk -> samples + dedupe helpers, ana -> docs + migration guide, saurabh -> build QA vector. let's sync next Tue.
